{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rayter Sector Subspace Broadcast Network''' was a program initiated by the [[Rayter Sector High Advisory Council]] to replicate a portion of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] to deliver official newscasts, sector cultural events, and official proclamations. It consisted of sixty-four [[Subspace relay station/Legends|subspace relay stations]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
